title: FinReflectKG - EvalBench: Benchmarking Financial KG with Multi-Dimensional Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Implementing a principle of conservatism in the LLM-as-a-judge prompt, instructing it to default to a negative decision (0) whenever the evidence is uncertain or ambiguous.
Enforcing strict locality by prompting the LLM evaluator to not infer or add any information beyond the provided source text.
Explicitly instructing the LLM judge to not let the order or placement of sentences in the source text affect its evaluation decisions.
Instructing the LLM judge to ensure that the length or surface form of the candidate triples does not influence the evaluation outcome.
